name: Charlotte Dawson
story: Women in Spatial + Survey’s committee biography records Charlotte Dawson’s work as a GIS analyst and cartographer, followed by research for the Geographic Board. She joined Stantec as New Zealand GIS Team Leader in 2020 and chaired the WIS+S committee in 2021. Her record connects technical practice, public-sector research and professional community leadership.
